name: Caste Certificate
description: Official certificate of caste category (OBC, SC, ST, NT) for use in scholarship and employment applications

name: Marriage Certificate
description: Official government registration of marriage for legal and visa purposes

name: Pension Application
description: Apply for old age pension, widow pension, or disability pension monthly cash benefit

name: Family Member Change
description: Add or remove a family member from the family registry — birth, death, marriage, or migration

name: Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for citizens aged 60+ with family income below ₹2 lakh

name: BPL Ration Card
description: Below Poverty Line ration card providing subsidised food grains for families with income below ₹1.5 lakh

name: Post-Matric OBC Scholarship
description: Scholarship for OBC students pursuing post-matriculation education. Covers tuition and maintenance

name: Widow Pension
description: Monthly pension support for widows with family income below ₹1.5 lakh

name: CM Girl Child Education Grant
description: One-time education grant for girls aged 18-25 pursuing higher education. All castes eligible

name: Disability Pension
description: Monthly pension for persons with disability above 40%. All castes eligible

name: Farmer Distress Relief
description: Emergency financial relief for farmers affected by crop failure, drought or flood. Income below ₹2L

name: Anganwadi Nutrition Scheme
description: Supplementary nutrition and health services for children under 6 and pregnant mothers

name: Housing Subsidy Scheme
description: Housing construction subsidy under PMAY for families without permanent dwelling. All castes eligible

name: Skill Development Scheme
description: Free vocational training in IT, tailoring, construction, electrical and other trades. Youth aged 18-35

name: Ayushman Bharat Health Card
description: Free health insurance cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation. BPL families

name: MGNREGA Employment
description: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year for rural households. All castes eligible

name: PM Mudra Yojana (Micro-loan)
description: Micro-business loan up to ₹10 lakh for small entrepreneurs and self-employed persons. No collateral

name: Krishi Sinchai Yojana
description: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment for farmers. SC/ST/NT farmers get higher subsidy

name: CM Digital Literacy Scheme
description: Free computer and smartphone literacy training. Certificate programme for citizens aged 18-50

name: Mid-Day Meal Scheme
description: Free school meals for students in government schools. Automatic enrolment for enrolled students

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
description: Cash incentive for institutional delivery in government hospitals. BPL pregnant women, all castes

name: Pre-Matric SC/ST Scholarship
description: Scholarship for SC and ST students in class 1-10. Covers books, uniform, and maintenance allowance

name: Swachh Bharat Toilet Grant
description: One-time grant of ₹12,000 for constructing a household toilet. Rural households without toilet facility

name: Old Age Home Support
description: Monthly allowance and facilities for senior citizens aged 70+ living alone or in old age homes
